messages.content: Been nothing but snow out here for a week. Getting lonely
That sounds really hard. I hear those stretches. How's your health doing?
Fine mostly. Blood sugar's been 130s-140s, hit 156 yesterday. Just miss talking to people
I get it. I'll log those numbers. Real talk though - I can't fill the loneliness piece. That needs your nurse or doctor or someone local
Yeah I figured. Just had to try
Fair. Anything with your meds or readings I'm your person. Next check-in next week?
Yeah, do that. Thanks for not pretending
Next week set. Anything comes up health-wise, reach out. You ok?

theme: lonely, just wanted to talk, nobody has been by since the snow
